result.summary: Found 2 visual issues on the page, primarily related to truncated content in the horizontal scroll section.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' section is cut off mid-word. The card image is intentionally partially visible to hint at horizontal scrolling, but the text label beneath it is also clipped, making the name unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Text labels below horizontally scrollable cards should not be clipped by the parent container overflow. Ensure the restaurant name label has enough width or wraps properly, or use ellipsis ('Trattoria Piccolo...') so it reads as a complete, intentional truncation rather than a broken cut.

issues.description: The last category filter pill (rightmost, partially visible) is cut off with no scroll indicator or affordance visible, making it unclear to users that the filter row is horizontally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle fade/gradient on the right edge of the filter row, or display a partial pill more deliberately to signal scrollability. Alternatively, add a scroll indicator icon.
